verdict.rationale: JumpCloud serves a downloadable YAML API description at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml, which documents endpoints such as the Graph traversal GETs and appears to be an OpenAPI-style spec for its RESTful API. The 404s on conventional paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) do not contradict this; they only show the spec sits at a non-standard location. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the YAML is OpenAPI or another standard format, evidence of a spec for the v1 API, discoverability at conventional paths, and independent hands-on corroboration.
